{{nihongo|'''Karukomuranimasu Shrine'''|軽樹村坐神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Yamato Province]].

It is a {{ill|Shikinai Taisha|Q134917288|qid=Q134917288}}, and its former {{ill|Shakaku|ja|社格|ko|사격 (신토)|zh|社格|qid=Q10444029}} was {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}.

=== Enshrined deity ===
* '''{{ill|Emperor Ōjin|Q317997|qid=Q317997|lt=Homudawake-no-Mikoto}}'''

''Gogun Jinjaki'' identifies the deities as Hikoza-no-Kami and Shiraga-no-Ō. These two are described in the ''{{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|de|Shinsen Shōjiroku|fr|Shinsen shōjiroku|ja|新撰姓氏録|ko|신찬성씨록|ru|Синсэн сёдзироку|zh|新撰姓氏錄|qid=Q1045362}}'' (Sakyō, imperial branch, lower rank): "Shiraga-no-Ō, descendant of Hikoza... in the reign of Emperor Seimu, was granted 3,000 yo of Karu land... hence bore the surname Karu no Agaso," and they are also considered to be ancestors enshrined by the ancient Karu clan.

=== History ===
=== General history ===
The founding era is unknown. In the ''{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}'' it is listed as a major shrine, receiving offerings for Tsukinami and Niiname rites. Afterward it gradually declined, and even its enshrined deity became unknown; it was called {{ill|Hachiman shrine|Q11390939|qid=Q11390939}} until early modern times. Under the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=former shrine ranking system}}, it was listed as a village shrine.

=== Divine rank ===
* {{ill|859|Q23897|qid=Q23897}} (Ten'an 3), {{ill|January 27|Q2284|qid=Q2284}}: promoted from Junior Fifth Rank Lower to Junior Fifth Rank Upper (''{{ill|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|Q1052981|qid=Q1052981}}'') - written as "Karukomura no Kami"

=== Access ===
*5 minutes on foot from {{ill|Kashiharajingū-nishiguchi Station|Q6374284|qid=Q6374284}} on the {{ill|Minami Osaka Line|Q901342|qid=Q901342}} of {{ill|Kintetsu Railway|Q1531085|qid=Q1531085}}.
